title: SEV-2: negative on-hand for LH-LAMP-03 after the Lamp Week deploy
voice: PagerDuty paged at 02:10 UTC: 'negative on-hand for SKU LH-LAMP-03'. By the time the on-call opened the dashboard, 40 customers had ordered stock we do not have and the webhook-failure rate monitor was also warning.
The Lamp Week deploy went out at 22:40 the evening before. The on-call followed runbook RB-101, bumped the stock count by hand and went back to bed; the alert fired again twenty minutes later.

I need an impact statement, the evidence chain across the monitor, the incident, the traces and the code, the likely cause, a mitigation that holds until morning, and a written incident report by 09:00.

money.note: 40 × $59.00 unfulfillable; vouchers and care time on top

impact.trust: Second overnight page in two weeks; leadership asks whether flash sales should pause

constraints: No deploy before 08:00 without IC approval
Site stays up; Lamp Week continues
No manual stock edits (that is what RB-101 got wrong)
deadline: Incident report by 09:00 UTC; post-incident review within 3 days
